headline: Durk’s Team Files Emergency Motion to Include Akademiks Interview Clips
body: Trap Lore Ross reports Durk’s legal team filed an emergency motion with the judge to include additional clips from DJ Akademiks’ interview after Ak claimed the entire incident was scripted. The motion follows claims that Durk never denied Lul Pab’s murder in a recent Akademiks interview, which the judge noted would have been excluded if Durk had denied it. This development comes as jurors demand more digitized evidence before a verdict.

caption:
Durk’s legal team is pushing for more evidence from Akademiks’ interview to address claims of a scripted murder narrative. The judge has previously indicated that Durk’s admission of not denying Lul Pab’s murder would have allowed the clip to stay in the record. Jurors are now waiting for additional digital evidence before a verdict is reached.
